preferred_label: The Textual Criticism of Sumerian Literature
notes: Verified modern scholarly monograph published in 2012 as Journal of Cuneiform Studies Supplemental Series 3 by the American Schools of Oriental Research. It develops a causal and distribution-sensitive method for evaluating textual variation in copies of Sumerian literary compositions. The Work is not an ancient composition, physical manuscript, original text, composite edition, score, variant set, or universal textual state. Delnero's 2024 chapter Errors or Innovation? is a separate contained Work and supplies the newest direct control: textual stability, erasure, accepted variance, and creative change differ by corpus and transmission practice. Only bibliographic identity and an unreviewed source-reported authorship claim are admitted; no monograph payload, Expression, Edition, Item, manuscript, text, transliteration, translation, variant classification, semantic claim, graph relation, or canon state is created.
